props.name: actions
props.comment: Markup beside the heading, rendered as given — where an app puts a client island.

props.name: children
props.comment: The fields. Each takes `record` itself: there is no record context.

props.name: className
props.comment: A class name to apply to the header.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to show. Required: there is no record context to fall back on.

props.name: title
props.comment:
The heading, as a message key: translated through `i18n` when one is given,
printed as is otherwise. Unlike `<Show>`, a server component can call no
`useTranslate` hook, so pass `i18n` or a string you translated yourself.
Defaults to `defaultRecordRepresentation(record)`, which is never
translated.
